definition.scenario: T20 at Indian venues; second innings only; first known pre-delivery state per chase with 2-4 wickets down, 18-42 legal balls already bowled, required rate 12-20 RPO, and runs needed > 0.
definition.anchor: The first delivery in each chase meeting every condition; measurements start on that delivery.
definition.measurement_window: Anchor delivery through the innings, stopping before the first unknown-legality row. Unknown-legality rows and subsequent state-unknown deliveries are excluded.
definition.batter_runs_and_balls: Runs use the raw runs field; faced balls are known deliveries that are not wides. Byes and leg-byes are counted as one team run for target/state reconstruction, as in the confirmed source-data rule.
definition.boundary_and_dot_metrics: Boundary events are fours plus sixes; boundaries per 100 balls and dot percentage use batter balls faced as the denominator.
definition.stayed_to_over_16: Numerator: player was not dismissed before the 96th known legal ball. Denominator: player was at the crease before legal ball 96 and the known segment reached at least 96 legal balls. Innings without that opportunity are excluded.
definition.dismissals: is_wicket rows excluding retire-outs, retire-hurt rows, and obstruction labels.
definition.target: revised_target when present; otherwise first-innings raw total plus one, counting one run for each wide, no-ball, bye, or leg-bye event.
definition.rank_order: The displayed supplied list order is a user reference, not recalculated from raw data. The supplied table does not define a clutch-specific ranking formula.
definition.composite_formula: Raw-data rank: 50% adjusted strike-rate percentile + 30% adjusted-average percentile + 20% boundary-run-share percentile; boundary-run-share is boundary runs divided by batter runs. Adjusted SR uses a 60-ball cohort-baseline prior; adjusted average uses a 3-dismissal cohort-baseline prior. Raw figures remain displayed.
definition.phase_composite_formula: Death-over strike rate 25%, middle-over strike rate 15%, adjusted death-minus-middle strike-rate acceleration 20%, raw runs across middle and death phases 15%, death-minus-middle boundary events per 100 batter balls 15%, and adjusted average across both phases 10%. Each component is converted to a tie-aware percentile within the eligible clutch-qualified phase cohort before weighting. Higher is better for every component.
definition.phase_tie_breaker: Equal composite scores are ordered by more death-phase balls, then more combined middle/death runs, then player name and source ID.
definition.phase_scope: Raw Indian-venue T20 innings 1 and 2 across the available source history; middle phase is overid 7-15 and death phase is overid 16-20. Unknown-legality rows and all later deliveries in that innings are excluded. Batter balls are non-wide known deliveries; batter runs use the raw runs field.
definition.phase_sample_rule: Candidates need at least 30 batter balls in both middle and death phases. Raw strike rates and averages are displayed alongside adjusted values. Adjusted phase strike rates use a 60-ball cohort-baseline prior; adjusted average uses 3 prior dismissals. Raw average is not reported below 3 dismissals.
definition.final_batting_top_ten_logic: The user's approved top seven are retained in the stated order. Positions 8-10 are filled by the highest phase-composite alternatives among the remaining clutch-qualified eligible players. The phase composite is computed for the full eligible clutch cohort, while the approved top-seven order is held fixed per user instruction.
definition.reliability_gate: Ranked batters need at least 30 pressure balls and at least 3 qualifying clutch-window innings, plus the confirmed 2026 all-venue activity and 10-chase-innings gates. Players below these gates remain visible as review samples.
definition.recent_form_window: For each batter, latest 10 Indian-venue T20 second-innings batting innings are recomputed from raw deliveries and shown separately as form context. The composite remains based on the qualifying clutch-window innings; the recent-form figures are not mixed into the score because no extra form weight was specified.
definition.unweighted_diagnostics: Dot percentage and survival through over 16 are shown as diagnostics but are not part of the confirmed composite score.
definition.manual_exclusions: Rashid Khan (ID 4722), Dhruv Jurel (ID 7260), and Shashank Singh (ID 2756) are retained in the raw figures and excluded only from the final ranking at the user's request.
definition.previous_selection_gates: The confirmed 30-ball minimum, a 2026 T20 appearance at any venue, and at least 10 known Indian-venue second-innings chase appearances apply. A 3-qualifying-pressure-innings reliability gate was added so a single strong pressure innings cannot be presented as a reliable top-ten record.

ranking_status: Ranked 16 eligible batters by the confirmed composite after the 3-pressure-innings reliability gate and 3 user-requested exclusions.
